_source: Generated by fixtures/voice/gen_av1_rtp_vectors.py, independent of Rust: AOM AV1 RTP v1.0.0 sections 4-5, AV1 LEB128/OBU syntax, RFC 4588 RTX, RFC 8285 one-byte extensions, and pycryptodome rtpsize sealing. All keys, packets, and codec bodies are synthetic. These are not decoder or DAVE authentication vectors. Expected output is serialized directly from source OBU objects, not decoded from generated packets.

_schema.frames: In-order payloads; sequence=(first_sequence+index)&65535, one timestamp, markers[index]. Compare obu_stream or dave_obu_stream byte-for-byte. new_sequence is the first aggregation header N bit, not parsed codec data.
_schema.delivery_cases: frame names a frames[] entry. arrival_order indexes its payloads and may repeat indices. Only complete frames may be emitted, once.
_schema.malformed: Each case starts with fresh receiver state and explicit packet headers. No frame is emitted. reject means malformed input; drop_incomplete means a frame never completes. finish=deadline requires expiring pending state. Reserved bits use strict-zero validation, not a claim that AOM mandates all receiver rejections. Error names are semantic, not Rust enum variants.
_schema.transport: frame identifies both output expectations. Each mode has five media packets then three RTX repairs. arrival_order indexes mode.packets. clear is AAD; plaintext includes encrypted extension bytes and RTX OSN; payload excludes extensions and RTX OSN. RTX retains timestamp/marker and uses new SSRC/PT/sequence/nonce. Repeated datagram indices model network duplication; fresh RTX indices model authenticated duplicate repair.
_schema.dave_obu_stream: After ignoring TD/type8, only the terminal retained OBU clears obu_has_size_field and omits its length; all earlier sizes are canonical. Padding remains. This is framing only, not encrypted DAVE traffic.

frames.name: sequence-start-keyframe-w1
frames.notes: N is the sequence-start/keyframe hint; only the first packet sets N.

frames.name: delta-w3-nonzero-layer-ids
frames.notes: Both extension headers carry temporal_id=1 and spatial_id=1.

frames.name: delta-two-byte-element-and-obu-lengths
frames.notes: Element sizes 128/129; canonical OBU body sizes 127/128.

frames.name: fragmented-extension-header-w1
frames.notes: First fragment ends before the OBU extension byte.

frames.name: sequence-start-mixed-fragments-wrap
frames.notes: Packet 2 ends the old fragment, contains a complete OBU, and begins a new fragment. Sequence numbers are 65533,65534,65535,0,1.

frames.name: legal-rtp-size-fields-w2
frames.notes: Size fields are legal on RTP; the first is nonminimal and normalized.

frames.name: legal-rtp-size-field-split-leb128-w0
frames.notes: First fragment ends inside the two-byte internal OBU size field.

frames.name: legal-eight-byte-element-length
frames.notes: Nonminimal eight-byte LEB128 encodes element length 3.

frames.name: legal-eight-byte-obu-size
frames.notes: Nonminimal eight-byte LEB128 body size 2 is canonicalized.

frames.name: ignore-temporal-delimiter-and-tile-list
frames.notes: Receiver MUST ignore both TD and tile list, even if sender kept them.

frames.name: ignore-fragmented-tile-list
frames.notes: Discard type 8 only after its fragments have been consumed correctly.

frames.name: retain-padding-including-zero-size
frames.notes: Generic RTP keeps padding. Last empty OBU is 7a00, or 78 at DAVE boundary.

malformed.name: empty-payload
malformed.reason: No aggregation header.

malformed.name: aggregation-without-elements-w0
malformed.reason: At least one OBU element is required.

malformed.name: aggregation-without-element-w1
malformed.reason: Implicit final OBU length is zero.

malformed.name: zero-element-length-w0
malformed.reason: An element cannot omit even its OBU header.

malformed.name: truncated-element-body
malformed.reason: Length is present but no element bytes follow.

malformed.name: truncated-element-leb128
malformed.reason: Continuation byte has no next LEB128 byte.

malformed.name: truncated-multibyte-element-leb128
malformed.reason: Length ends before a terminating byte.

malformed.name: unterminated-eight-byte-element-length
malformed.reason: Byte 8 must have its continuation bit clear.

malformed.name: overlong-nine-byte-element-length
malformed.reason: Length 3 encoded using forbidden ninth byte.

malformed.name: element-length-uint32-overflow
malformed.reason: Decoded length 2^32 violates AV1's UINT32_MAX bound.

malformed.name: eight-byte-element-length-uint32-overflow
malformed.reason: Terminated 8-byte value is greater than UINT32_MAX.

malformed.name: element-length-overlong-and-uint64-overflow
malformed.reason: Malicious ten-byte integer is neither AV1 LEB128 nor u64.

malformed.name: element-length-exceeds-frame-bound
malformed.reason: Declared length exceeds 2 MiB and available packet bytes.

malformed.name: element-length-exceeds-payload
malformed.reason: Declared length is larger than the payload remainder.

malformed.name: truncated-length-after-complete-element
malformed.reason: Trailing LEB128 is incomplete, not a second OBU.

malformed.name: w2-missing-final-element
malformed.reason: Explicit first element consumes all bytes; implicit second is empty.

malformed.name: w3-only-two-elements
malformed.reason: Second OBU header is misread as an impossible explicit element length.

malformed.name: w2-missing-first-length
malformed.reason: W=2 requires a length before its first element.

malformed.name: w0-missing-final-length
malformed.reason: W=0 requires a length before every element.

malformed.name: w1-unexpected-length-before-final
malformed.reason: Forbidden final length 3 becomes an invalid reserved-bit OBU header.

malformed.name: reserved-aggregation-bit-1
malformed.reason: Strict-zero reserved aggregation-bit policy.

malformed.name: reserved-aggregation-bit-2
malformed.reason: Strict-zero reserved aggregation-bit policy.

malformed.name: reserved-aggregation-bit-4
malformed.reason: Strict-zero reserved aggregation-bit policy.

malformed.name: obu-forbidden-bit
malformed.reason: AV1 obu_forbidden_bit must be zero.

malformed.name: obu-reserved-bit
malformed.reason: AV1 obu_reserved_1bit must be zero; strict input policy rejects it.

malformed.name: obu-extension-reserved-bit-1
malformed.reason: Extension's low three reserved bits must be zero.

malformed.name: obu-extension-reserved-bit-2
malformed.reason: Extension's low three reserved bits must be zero.

malformed.name: obu-extension-reserved-bit-4
malformed.reason: Extension's low three reserved bits must be zero.

malformed.name: truncated-obu-extension
malformed.reason: Extension flag is set but extension header is missing.

malformed.name: missing-internal-obu-size
malformed.reason: Size flag is set but no size field follows.

malformed.name: truncated-internal-obu-size
malformed.reason: Internal OBU size LEB128 is unterminated.

malformed.name: internal-obu-size-exceeds-element
malformed.reason: Internal body size 5 exceeds two available bytes.

malformed.name: internal-obu-size-leaves-trailing-data
malformed.reason: An OBU element contains bytes beyond its declared OBU size.

malformed.name: overlong-nine-byte-internal-obu-size
malformed.reason: Internal body size uses a forbidden ninth LEB128 byte.

malformed.name: internal-obu-size-uint32-overflow
malformed.reason: Internal body size 2^32 violates AV1's size bound.

malformed.name: n-and-z-set
malformed.reason: New sequence cannot start with a continuation: N=1 requires Z=0.

malformed.name: continuation-without-start
malformed.reason: Z=1 but there is no preceding fragmented OBU.

malformed.name: middle-continuation-without-start
malformed.reason: Z=Y=1 cannot create a fragment without an earlier start.

malformed.name: fragment-tail-without-z
malformed.reason: Continuation packet incorrectly claims to start a new OBU.

malformed.name: z-after-complete-obu
malformed.reason: A complete nonfragmented OBU cannot be continued.

malformed.name: marker-on-incomplete-final-y
malformed.reason: Marker packet still advertises an unfinished final OBU.

malformed.name: incomplete-final-y-at-deadline
malformed.reason: No marker or continuation completes the last Y=1 fragment.

malformed.name: middle-packet-ends-old-starts-unfinished-new
malformed.reason: Old OBU ends, but the new last OBU has Y=1 at marker.

malformed.name: fragment-crosses-timestamp
malformed.reason: A continuation cannot cross a temporal-unit timestamp boundary.
